text:
rachel: FYI customers on Vercel edge reported runtime failures after we published @redwood/sdk@1.3.7. Error: 'Unexpected token 'export'' and stack traces show minified bundles with no sourcemaps.

sam: I pulled the tarball with npm pack. package.json inside the tarball has exports.import -> ./dist/index.cjs and the .mjs file is missing from the package. That explains the edge complaint.

jess: oh no. Our build pipeline produces both .cjs and .mjs locally but looks like the npm publish step filters out .mjs and .map files. Could be files array or .npmignore.

sam: Quick mitigation: publish 1.3.8 with corrected exports import -> ./dist/index.mjs and include dist/*.mjs/dist/*.map in files. Also add a rollback note to support.

rachel: agree. Also add CI validation that runs npm pack and asserts presence of: dist/index.mjs, dist/index.cjs, dist/index.d.ts, dist/index.mjs.map. Failing the check should block the release job.

jess: created a draft PR to fix package.json and add pack-check job: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/435. The pack-check uses tar -tf on the npm pack artifact.

dev-bot: [release-validation] pack-check failed for tag v1.3.7: missing files: dist/index.mjs, dist/index.mjs.map. See artifact: https://ci.example.com/artifacts/7890

sam: Also propose adding a tiny smoke in the edge-matrix that imports the package as ESM and runs a function that returns a string. If import fails the job fails. Could run in node 18+ with --conditions or in a worker-like environment.

jess: I'll land the package fix and the CI pack-check. We'll republish and notify support to re-test. Adding a changelog apology and note to breaking changes if any.

rachel: add me to the PR for review. After publishing let's confirm with the two affected customers and close their tickets.

sam: thumbs up. After 1.3.8 I'll run local edge test and confirm sourcemaps show up in stack traces.

jess: publishing patch now, tagging 1.3.8 and triggering release workflow.
